data.one_liner: Native PayPal integration for Flutter without WebViews.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that enables native PayPal checkout flows on Android and iOS devices. It handles user authentication, cart management, order execution, and callbacks for payment statuses.
use_when: You need to accept PayPal payments natively inside your Flutter app
You want to avoid using WebViews for the PayPal checkout process
avoid_when: You require web-only support without mobile platform requirements
You want a generalized payment gateway supporting multiple non-PayPal providers
strengths: Provides a native SDK integration instead of WebViews
Supports both Android and iOS platforms
Includes order callbacks for success, cancellation, errors, and shipping changes
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration and dashboard setups (such as exact return URLs and enabling SDK options)
Strict limit on the number of purchase unit items (4 to 6 items)
data.setup_notes: Requires AndroidManifest.xml updates, configuring internet permissions, minimum SDK version 21 on Android, and enabling Jetifier. Requires setting up return URLs and configuring credentials on the PayPal Developer Dashboard.
